items.source: Note that this reader depends on access to an HttpMessageReader<Part> for the actual parsing of multipart content. The purpose of this reader is to collect the parts into a map.
items.translation: 请注意，此读取器依赖于对 `HttpMessageReader<Part>` 的访问，以实际解析多部分内容。此读取器的目的是将各部分收集到一个映射中。

items.source: Whether the given object type is supported by this reader.
items.translation: 给定对象类型是否由该读取器支持。

items.source: Return the configured parts reader.
items.translation: 返回配置的部件读取器。

items.source: Read from the input message and decode to a stream of objects.

items.source: Read from the input message and decode to a single object.
items.translation: 从输入消息中读取并解码为单个对象。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this reader. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canWrite(elementType, null). The list may also exclude media types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use HttpMessageReader.getReadableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此读取器支持的媒体类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canWrite(elementType, null) 进行保护。该列表也可能排除仅针对特定元素类型支持的媒体类型。或者，使用 HttpMessageReader.getReadableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) 获取更精确的列表。
